title: Lead Software Engineer

additionalInformation.label: RFIMS Operations, Maintenance and Sustainment follow-on contract

description: Led an 11-person team and served as scrum master for a radio-frequency data analysis system spanning embedded collection systems and AWS-based classification. Designed the cloud architecture and replaced a throughput-constrained workflow engine with a more scalable implementation.
highlights: Designed major system components in MagicDraw before implementation and helped coordinate delivery across an 11-person team.
Built the AWS architecture around EC2, Route 53, and RDS to host data-classification and workflow services.
Replaced a Groovy workflow engine that could not meet throughput needs with a JavaScript and Node.js backend designed to scale more easily.
Developed the JavaScript and React frontend used to operate and monitor processing workflows.
Automated cloud infrastructure with Python and Ansible and established continuous integration for the project.
